name: challenger_policy_v2
written_before: any challenger forecast resolved (first possible resolution: 2026-11-05)
extends: challenger_policy_v1 (loss definitions and the interim futility rule are unchanged)

pairing.rule: challenger and champion (M1_logistic) forecasts are paired only if origin_ms, target AND as_of_ms (information cutoff) are identical; pairs violating this are excluded and counted in every report

inference.ci: moving-block bootstrap, block 7 origins, 2000 draws, seed 0 (24 h targets: windows do not overlap; block covers weekly seasonality and serial dependence)

multiplicity.search: the challengers come from 12 searched feature-target tests (F-FCAST 6 + F-FCAST-2 6) on exposed data; selection does not bias the prospective test, which uses new data only; it is disclosed, not corrected
multiplicity.prospective: Holm across the efficacy family at each look

efficacy_family.rule: members are the challenger-targets with >= 50% power at look 3 (730 pairs) for HALF their screening effect (winner's-curse shrinkage), alpha 0.01; computed from screening-period block-bootstrap CIs before any outcome
efficacy_family.exploratory_rule: keep issuing (cost ~0, informs the combined weekday model), report descriptively, never eligible for promotion under this plan

sequential.control: Bonferroni over looks (total one-sided 0.05 per family); Holm within each look over the family
sequential.futility: challenger_policy_v1 rule, may only stop a challenger (cannot inflate type I error)
sequential.no_unplanned_looks: efficacy is only evaluated at planned looks; dashboards show descriptive running means labelled 'not a test'

promotion_requires: reject at a planned look after Holm
same sign at the previous planned look if any
180 resolved pairs alone is NOT sufficient evidence
